description: PubMed citation retrieval. One call returns: PMID list, per-paper { title, journal, MeSH terms, authors, PubMed record URL (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/<PMID>/ — resolves to the citation/abstract record page, not guaranteed full text), publication date, stale flag }. Abstract full text is NOT returned inline; see abstract_note for where to fetch it. Structured JSON, no free-text upsell in result. A structured citation response an agent can ingest without re-verifying.

freshness_days.description: Flag papers older than N days as stale

intent_token.description: Fresh single-use token returned by register_intent; required for this gated tool.

n.description: Number of papers to return (default 5, max 10)

topic.description: Biomedical topic, condition, drug, or question

name: pubmed_evidence
